content: The policyholder has a period of 30 days (for policies sourced electronically or via distance marketing) and 15 days (for physical policies) from the date of receipt of the policy document to review the terms and conditions. If disagreed, the policyholder may cancel by stating the reasons, receiving a full refund of premiums paid less proportionate risk premium, medical examination expenses, and stamp duty.

A grace period of 30 days is allowed for payment of yearly, half-yearly, and quarterly premiums. For monthly premium payment mode, a grace period of 15 days is allowed. The policy remains in full force during the grace period. If premium remains unpaid at the expiry of the grace period, the policy lapses.

Special Exit Value (Zero-Cost Exit): The policyholder can terminate the policy and receive a complete refund of all total premiums paid (excluding taxes and rider costs) provided the policy is active, the applicant has attained age 65 or completed 25 policy years, and the exit option is exercised within the designated window before policy termination.

As per individual life insurance tax regulations, individual pure term life insurance premiums enjoy a 0% effective GST rate for individual policyholders, and qualify for deduction under Section 80C of the Income Tax Act up to statutory limits.
